items.title: Epoch AI data centers (global) — 2026-10-05
items.summary: Epoch AI covers 93 large AI data centers (72 drawing power now): 13.7 GW current power, 14.3M H100-equivalents, 10 countries with capacity. By power: United States 11.76 GW (86%), Malaysia 0.89 GW (7%), China 0.73 GW (5%), United Kingdom 0.09 GW (1%). Indiana: 3 sites, 1.09 GW = 7.9% of the covered global total (Anthropic-Amazon New Carlisle (910 MW), Meta Jeffersonville (178 MW), Google Fort Wayne (0 MW)). Covered set only, not world capacity; skewed to the US. Dataset updated 2026-10-02.
